semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company supports semiconductor manufacturing through facility management and advanced equipment but does not directly produce semiconductor devices.
summary: The Swedish Trade & Invest Council promotes Nordic innovation in high-tech facility management and advanced semiconductor equipment. They provide solutions for energy-efficient operations, contamination control, and advanced lithography technologies, enhancing the efficiency and sustainability of semiconductor manufacturing processes.
capabilities: Energy-efficient heat transfer and cooling solutions for semiconductor facilities
Nanoimprint lithography and resist processing equipment
Customized industrial packaging and logistics solutions

regional_presence.Sweden: The company highlights various Swedish innovations in semiconductor equipment and facility management.
regional_presence.Finland: Finland is noted for its advanced semiconductor process solutions and high-power laser systems.
